description: This file is a shell script containing tests for fsck buffer handling in Git, including functions for resetting state, adding objects, and checking buffer truncations and errors.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the test environment by creating an empty base file.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a content line to the base file, specifying the object type.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a buffer truncation test on a specified object type, verifying error messages.

methods.name: ident_checks
methods.description: Performs a series of validation checks on commit or tag object fields.
